# tissue_mast_policy (Resource)

An escalation policy: who a page goes to, and who it goes to next while nobody acknowledges it. Attach it to a channel or vital with `policy_id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tissue_mast_policy" "default" {
  name              = "default"
  repeat_every_secs = 1800

  steps = [
    { target = "oncall", rotation_id = tissue_mast_rotation.primary.id, priority = "page" },
    { target = "next", rotation_id = tissue_mast_rotation.primary.id, priority = "page", after_secs = 300 },
    { target = "everyone", priority = "page", after_secs = 900 },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The policy's name.
- `steps` (Attributes List) The steps, in order. The first fires at once. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--steps))

### Optional

- `repeat_count` (Number) How many times the steps repeat, 1 to 10. Defaults to 3 when `repeat_every_secs` is set.
- `repeat_every_secs` (Number) Start the steps over this many seconds after the last one, 60 up to a week. Leave it out for no repeat.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the policy was made.
- `id` (String) The policy id, `po_...`.

<a id="nestedatt--steps"></a>
### Nested Schema for `steps`

Required:

- `priority` (String) `page`, `loud` or `quiet`.
- `target` (String) Who the step pages: `oncall` (whoever holds `rotation_id`), `next` (whoever has the rotation's next shift), `everyone`, `user` or `channel`.

Optional:

- `after_secs` (Number) Seconds after the step before, up to a week. Ignored on the first step.
- `channel_id` (String) The channel a `channel` step sends to, `mc_...`.
- `rotation_id` (String) The rotation an `oncall` or `next` step reads. Without one the step pages everyone.
- `user_id` (String) The person a `user` step pages.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import tissue_mast_policy.default default
terraform import tissue_mast_policy.default po_0b6e94d2c13a4f8e
```
